title: Completion comparison for a closed immersion
statement: theorem closedImmersion_coherentFormal_equivalence_completion {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) : ∃ θ : ObjectProperty.ι (RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward i ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor I ≅ ObjectProperty.ι (RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace) ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor (I.comap i) ⋙ (Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ Z.Modules X.Modules).obj (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i), ∀ (G : CoherentModules Z) (n : ℕ), formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj G.obj) ≫ (θ.hom.app G).app (op n) = (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map (formalModuleQuotientπ (I.comap i) (n + 1) G.obj)

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Tags 087T, 088A and equation 0880

proof.text: A closed immersion into a Noetherian scheme has Noetherian source. Apply the locally Noetherian coherence criterion to obtain quasi-coherence for every coherent G. Take the quotient comparison family with projection, module-map naturality and level naturality supplied by closedImmersion_pushforward_idealPowers. Apply NatIso.ofComponents first over the positive quotient levels and then over coherent modules. The level and module naturality clauses supply the two naturality proofs. The projection clause gives the required equality at op n.
